original_commitment: Identify immune-related genes by comparing ICI responders versus nonresponders across melanoma, NSCLC and urothelial/public GEO-SRA studies.
current_evidence: Multiple protocol-named study families and public processed expression objects exist; no canonical admitted population exists.
revised_acquisition_route: Resolve originating studies/publication families; retrieve processed objects; build patient/specimen/assay and endpoint registries; admit by branch.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Preserve the scientific aim while replacing accession-level/sample-level assumptions with patient-level admission.
decision_or_resolution_needed: No material endpoint change unless user rejects exact-ORR policy.

original_commitment: Approximately 200 patient samples across six ICI cohorts.
current_evidence: Seven accession strings are named; GSE91061 and SRP094781 are one GEO/SRA study family. Repository sample counts include serial/repeated specimens.
revised_acquisition_route: Report verified patients, specimens and assays separately; do not force a target N.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Sample/assay counts cannot be silently interpreted as patient counts.
decision_or_resolution_needed: Approve treating the number as an estimate, not quota.

current_evidence: Official GEO links GSE91061 to SRP094781; 109 RNA-seq samples, 51 pre, 58 on, 65 patients; processed objects listed.
source_status: same study/publication family; object route public
revised_acquisition_route: One study record; deduplicate aliases; reconstruct patient/treatment/specimen/assay/outcome; stratify prior ipilimumab.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Two accessions are not two independent cohorts.

current_evidence: Official GEO lists 28 pretreatment melanoma samples and Pt27A/Pt27B; processed FPKM route and SRA relation.
revised_acquisition_route: Preserve multiple specimens; select baseline deterministically; verify response categories and assay object.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Deposited samples are not automatically independent patients.

current_evidence: Official GEO lists 90 RNA assays, BACI165 sequenced twice, processed-only route, and a replaced matrix version.
revised_acquisition_route: Resolve repeat assay, current matrix headers, patient key, endpoint and timing; hash exact current objects.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Repeat sequencing and matrix-version history affect patient and object identity.

current_evidence: Official GEO lists 27 ICI-treated NSCLC samples and processed expression; current Paper A evidence does not establish a patient-level ORR mapping.
source_status: object available; endpoint route unresolved for ORR
revised_acquisition_route: Recover original patient endpoint definition; otherwise route only to a separately named survival/progression branch.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: PFS/OS or unspecified benefit cannot be converted to objective response.

current_evidence: Official GEO lists 37 assays, processed counts and repeated patient/date-labelled material.
revised_acquisition_route: Resolve publication family, response source, treatment episode, technical repeats and exact time windows.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Repeated samples and dated aliases cannot be mapped by row order.

current_evidence: Official GEO resolves SRP183455 to GSE126044 with 16 RNA patients; linked GSE126043 methylation has 18 samples under GSE126045.
source_status: public processed RNA and methylation objects
patient_level_feasibility: baseline candidate; exact multi-omics pairing unknown
revised_acquisition_route: One publication family; construct modality-specific patient/specimen crosswalk and linked denominator.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Same study family does not prove all modalities are paired.

current_evidence: Riaz provides clear pre/on source material; other longitudinal sources require reconstruction. No validated pair matrix exists.
revised_acquisition_route: Build patient-timepoint long and prespecified pair matrices; separate on, post, progression and regimen-change windows.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Broad pre/on labels are insufficient for response-by-time inference.

original_commitment: Downstream TCGA-PRAD evaluation of responder-associated genes.
current_evidence: Current A/B specifications require a frozen versioned handoff; acquisition does not perform the prostate analysis.
patient_level_feasibility: outside Paper A patient registry except provenance handoff
revised_acquisition_route: Release frozen A products and provenance/exposure metadata to B; no final-test outcome leakage.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Separate acquisition from downstream biological analysis.

current_evidence: Linked study families exist; exact same-patient/same-time/same-specimen intersections are not yet verified.
revised_acquisition_route: Use explicit pairing states and report modality, linked-patient, same-time and same-specimen denominators.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Largest modality count is not paired N.

original_commitment: Raw-count processing and DESeq2/limma depending on source.
current_evidence: Several protocol sources provide defensible processed objects; raw reprocessing would add cost and validation burden.
revised_acquisition_route: Prefer source-deposited processed objects; raw reprocessing only by amendment.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Acquisition should not default to FASTQ/BAM/IDAT processing when interpretable processed objects exist.

original_commitment: Use equal-sized patient groups/cohorts for comparative analysis.
current_evidence: No scientific acquisition requirement justifies discarding valid patients to equalize N.
revised_acquisition_route: Retain all eligible patients and address imbalance in the analysis specification.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Equal N is not a condition of valid patient identification or cohort admission.

original_commitment: ComBat batch correction between PRAD and LUAD.
current_evidence: Cancer type is biological context, not merely technical batch; acquisition should preserve source/cancer structure.
revised_acquisition_route: Record platform/source/batch; do not make cross-cancer ComBat an acquisition default.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Cross-cancer adjustment can remove biology and belongs to a separately justified analysis.
status: corrected; deferred to Paper B analysis

original_commitment: TCGA-LUAD as an ICI-responsive positive control.
current_evidence: Untreated TCGA-LUAD lacks observed ICI-response labels for this purpose.
revised_acquisition_route: Label LUAD as comparator/context; clinical ICI claims require treated cohorts.
reason_for_addition_exclusion_reclassifi: Molecular resemblance is not observed treatment response.
